topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines how previously introduced immune components will be integrated.

topics.label: Principles of innate immune recognition via PAMPs and DAMPs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue injury by identifying conserved microbial and damage-associated molecular patterns.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor pathways and the inflammasome
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine specific receptor families and their downstream signaling mechanisms that drive pro-inflammatory gene transcription and cytokine maturation.

topics.label: Inflammatory cell recruitment, trafficking, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte extravasation into inflamed tissue, facilitate lymphatic drainage to lymph nodes, and potentially trigger severe systemic complications such as septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that shut down acute inflammatory responses, mediate tissue healing, and manage persistent insults through chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next lecture preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the upcoming lecture.
